title: oxossia rubrobracteata
intro: Oxossia rubrobracteata, commonly known as the Red-bracted Oxossia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Vaciniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions.
